regulator: Charity Commission for England and Wales
charity_definition: A charity registered with the Charity Commission under the Charities Act 2011. Covers England and Wales only; Scotland and Northern Ireland have their own regulators and registers.
register_scope: Main registered charities (linked_charity_number = 0) with status Registered
income_definition: latest_income from the register extract (latest financial period submitted)
has_spending_breakdown: partial (annual return part B, larger charities only)
cause_source: Charity Commission classification, type What (17 codes)
programme_country_source: Area of operation, type Country (country names)
comparability_note: Includes many very small charities, so typical income is low compared with other registers.
source: Charity Commission for England and Wales, Register of Charities (extract 2026-10-23)

charity_definition: A charity registered with the Canada Revenue Agency under the Income Tax Act, designated as a charitable organization, public foundation or private foundation.
register_scope: Charities that filed a T3010 return for a 2024 fiscal period (latest period per charity)
programme_country_source: T3010 Schedule 2 countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 plus CRA region codes)
comparability_note: Covers charities with a 2024 return; foundations are included and flagged.
source: Canada Revenue Agency, T3010 2024 open data

charity_definition: A charity registered with the ACNC under the Charities Act 2013 (Cth).
register_scope: ACNC register rows with an 11-digit ABN, joined to the 2024 Annual Information Statement where available
comparability_note: Charities without a 2024 AIS have no income figure; the size band (Small, Medium, Large) is kept separately.

charity_definition: An organisation recognised by the IRS as exempt under section 501(c)(3), as listed in the Exempt Organizations Business Master File. Exemption is a tax status, not a charity register.
income_definition: Form 990 revenue for the 500-return sample, otherwise BMF REVENUE_AMT (0 usually means no return with financials, e.g. 990-N filers)
cause_source: NTEE major group (first letter of the NTEE code)
programme_country_source: none loaded (Form 990 Schedule F not used yet)
comparability_note: Zero income usually means no financial return on file, not zero activity. Private foundations are flagged [VERIFY foundation codes].
source: IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File and Form 990 e-file data

regulator: Narodowy Instytut Wolności – CRSO (list of public benefit organisations)
legal_basis: Act of 24 April 2003 on public benefit activity and volunteering
charity_definition: Poland has no legal category called charity. Organizacja pożytku publicznego (OPP, public benefit organisation) is a status granted to NGOs such as foundations and associations; OPPs on the NIW-CRSO list can receive 1.5% of personal income tax.
register_scope: Organisations on the 2025 OPP 1.5% list (updated 13 Oct 2026); legal form and activity codes only for a 200-entity KRS sample
income_definition: none: OPP financial reports are not published as open bulk data
cause_source: PKD activity divisions for the KRS sample only
comparability_note: No income figures, and causes only for about 2% of organisations. Use Poland for counts and names, not finance comparisons.
source: Narodowy Instytut Wolności – CRSO, Wykaz OPP 1,5% (dane.gov.pl); Ministerstwo Sprawiedliwości, KRS Open API (sample)
